newsitem.title: TAIWAN: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - July 29.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - July 29.

text.p: These are the leading stories in the Taiwan press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
CHINA TIMES - Taiwan shuts unofficial trade office in Cambodia.
Workers in manufacturing sector get three percent pay rise from July.
UNITED DAILY NEWS - Philips Electronics NV decides to sell 100 million shares in Taiwan Semiconductor.
Taiwan closes Cambodia office, accusing Chinese communists as "black hand" behind scenes.
LIBERTY TIMES - Taiwan severs unofficial ties with Cambodia, closes office.
Taiwan to revise law governing sales of farmlands.
COMMERCIAL TIMES - Finance ministry to revise futures trading transaction tax system.
Loans extended by Taiwan banks to private sector rise sharply.
ECONOMIC DAILY NEWS - Central bank's monetary policy tends to be not too loose in face of stock bull run; central bank to consider whether to cut rediscount rate (at scheduled meeting on Thursday).
The Taiwan dollar rate tests its T$28 support level.
